_note: name; regex (Python re); covered_by (a script in bin/ or hooks/, or none); optional: raw (match the command text as written, default is the text with quoted strings and heredoc bodies dropped), code (a regex that must match the code text first), per_segment (match each part split on ; && || |), exclude (a segment that does not count), kind (method: covered by the method text, not a script). Spans are bounded so a long command cannot make a match slow. Edit here, not in bin/script-repeats or hooks/script-note.py. usage is the one line hooks/script-note.py shows for a family with a covering script.

families.name: style-slop-grep
families.usage: checks the lines you add (and untracked files) for dashes, arrows, slop and attribution. Run `style-scan` before a commit, and on a body file before `gh ... --body-file`.

families.name: mutation-check
families.usage: holds a change's production hunk out and requires its named test to fail. Run `holdout.sh --spec <file>`.

families.name: curl-smoke-check
families.usage: proves a deploy by the commit sha it reports, not a 200. Run `check-deployed-sha.sh <url> <sha>`.

families.name: inline-python-replace
families.usage: makes an exact text edit that fails unless the old text is there once. Run `replace FILE < blocks`.

families.name: direct-test-run
families.usage: queues tests in one lane so failures reach brain. Run `brain queue add <repo> <project> --filter ...`, then `test-phase`.

families.name: package-version-lookup
families.usage: prints the latest stable version and what each project here pins. Run `pkg-version <name> [--nuget|--npm]`.

families.name: worktree-status-sweep
families.usage: prints repo, branch, dirty count, ahead and behind, open PR and checks in under 30 lines. Run `where`, or `where --all` for every worktree.

families.name: graphql-review-threads
families.usage: lists every reason a PR cannot merge, unresolved review threads included. Run `pr-blockers.sh <pr>`.
